data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'anteios', meaning 'before, prior to, or superior to'. The name Antebi can be interpreted as 'Graceful God' or 'God's Grace'. In Christian traditions, it represents the love, kindness, and faithfulness of God. The name Antebi carries the meaning “Graceful God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Antebi usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is common in the Middle East and Mediterranean regions, particularly in Syria, Lebanon, and Cyprus. In these communities, the name represents the strong tether to their Christian heritage, passed down from generation to generation.

This connection to the divine extends beyond mere personal faith, as it shapes the collective identity of these communities.
